title: The Evolution of Artificial Intelligence in Antibody Design: From Structure-Based Engineering to Generative Models.
one_liner_zh: 该文综述了AI在抗体设计中的演进，涵盖结构预测与生成模型，虽为综述且对象为抗体，但核心涉及蛋白质结构计算与生成方法，对本课题有参考价值。
abstract: Background/Objectives: Artificial intelligence (AI) has transformed computational antibody engineering by enabling accurate prediction of antibody structures, rational optimization of therapeutic properties, and de novo antibody design. Recent advances in deep learning, protein language models, and generative AI have fundamentally changed the way antibodies are discovered and engineered. This review aims to present the historical evolution of computational antibody engineering, from early structure-based design strategies to modern AI-driven approaches, while highlighting the major computational tools, publicly available databases, current limitations, and future directions of the field. Methods: A comprehensive narrative review of the literature was conducted using PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, and Google Scholar. Original research articles, methodological studies, and review papers published between 1985 and 2026 were evaluated. Publications were selected according to their scientific relevance, methodological quality, and contribution to the historical development of computational antibody engineering. Results: The review describes the progression of antibody engineering from phage display and structure-based computational methods to machine learning, deep learning, protein language models, and generative artificial intelligence. It summarizes key public databases supporting antibody research, discusses advances in antibody structure prediction and developability assessment, and reviews recent generative models capable of designing antibody sequences and structures. Current challenges, including limited experimental validation, dataset bias, prediction of highly flexible regions, model interpretability, and clinical translation, are also discussed. Conclusions: Artificial intelligence has fundamentally reshaped computational antibody engineering by integrating sequence, structural, and functional information into increasingly accurate predictive and generative frameworks. Although important challenges remain, recent developments indicate that AI-driven approaches will play an increasingly central role in the discovery and optimization of next-generation therapeutic antibodies.
abstract_zh: 背景/目标：人工智能（AI）通过实现抗体结构的准确预测、治疗特性的合理优化以及抗体从头设计，已彻底改变了计算抗体工程领域。深度学习、蛋白质语言模型和生成式AI的最新进展，从根本上改变了抗体发现与工程化的方式。本综述旨在呈现计算抗体工程的历史演进，从早期基于结构的设计策略到现代AI驱动方法，同时重点介绍该领域的主要计算工具、公开数据库、当前局限性及未来方向。方法：使用PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science和Google Scholar对文献进行了全面的叙述性综述。评估了1985年至2026年间发表的原创研究文章、方法学研究和综述论文。根据科学相关性、方法学质量以及对计算抗体工程历史发展的贡献，对出版物进行了筛选。结果：本综述描述了抗体工程从噬菌体展示和基于结构的计算方法，到机器学习、深度学习、蛋白质语言模型和生成式人工智能的进展过程。总结了支持抗体研究的关键公共数据库，讨论了抗体结构预测和可开发性评估的进展，并回顾了近期能够设计抗体序列和结构的生成模型。还讨论了当前挑战，包括实验验证有限、数据集偏差、高度柔性区域的预测、模型可解释性以及临床转化。结论：人工智能通过将序列、结构和功能信息整合到日益准确的预测和生成框架中，从根本上重塑了计算抗体工程。尽管仍存在重要挑战，但近期发展表明，AI驱动方法将在下一代治疗性抗体的发现和优化中发挥越来越核心的作用。
